name: Enterocyte (gut cell)
short_description: Tall column-shaped absorptive cell with a dense apical brush border (microvilli). Absorbs nutrients from the gut lumen and passes them into the body; replaced every few days by intestinal stem cells and forms a barrier against gut microbes.

textbook.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; unmistakable tall narrow column ~4-5x taller than wide, dense uniform apical microvillar fringe with faint terminal web band, basal oval nucleus, apical/supranuclear mitochondria, rough ER, Golgi, smooth ER and a distinct tight-junction mark at the apicolateral corner, muted dusty textbook palette, thin outlines, dark charcoal background, no border, no text)

sem.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; single tall column-shaped cell shown mostly cropped to its apical/upper body, densely packed velvety carpet of short finger-like microvilli in warm golden-tan false colour with true 3D surface texture, hint of neighbouring cells at the lateral edges, shallow depth of field, dark uncluttered background, no internal organelles as expected for SEM, no border, no text)

3d.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; tall narrow column with soft global illumination and subsurface scattering on the membrane, dense upright brush border catching rim light, basal nucleus, apical mitochondria cluster, rough ER wrap, Golgi stack, smooth ER network and a dark junctional band at the top-lateral corner, natural warm biological tones (not neon, not monochrome), clean dark studio background, no border, no text)

watercolor.1: fail (gemini-2.5-flash-image; otherwise correct tall-column composition on full-bleed aged paper, but baked-in handwritten labels 'Terminal web' and a garbled second word appear directly in the image - violates the no-text rule)
